purpose: Document the scope and provenance boundary of the positive-crane-separation sensitivity checks.

fresh_first_round_probe.scope: Fresh batch-1 first-round formal rolling decoder under matched zero/1-m synthetic separation settings.
fresh_first_round_probe.scope_boundary: This is not a complete batch rollout, not a b3-r006/b3-r071 later-state re-decode, and not a field-safety threshold. Feasible records are decoder outputs without committed batches; strict pairings are limited to matching sequence hashes.

interpretation: The available rolling checkpoints are bound to zero-separation policy and provenance. Editing a checkpoint or its hash would fabricate history. A fresh first-round probe can test decoder sensitivity without relabelling the historical trajectory; it cannot establish full-rolling robustness.
claim_boundary: The released records do not certify crane-body clearance, complete-rolling policy robustness under positive separation, or an equipment safety threshold.
